summary: Deep research on FTMO execution optimization covering 12 sub-topics: timing, slippage, order types, platform infrastructure, failure pitfalls, spreads, 2026 rule changes, latency, multi-pair execution, exit optimization, weekend gaps, and scaling plan
key_findings: FTMO injects 200ms execution delay on all orders — must account for in backtests
Best Day Rule (NEW 2026): single day profit cannot exceed 50% of total positive days' profit
Weekend gaps occur ~20% of weekends; EUR/USD worst case 150 pips; close by Friday 19:00 UTC
FTMO scaling: 25% balance increase per 4-month cycle, 10% profit + 2 payouts required, upgrades to 90% split
At $200K+ accounts, split orders into 2-3 sub-orders to reduce market impact
EUR/USD-GBP/USD correlation +75-90: reduce combined size by 30%+ when >0.70
News restriction on funded accounts: 2-min blackout around NFP/CPI/FOMC
Time limit now UNLIMITED for challenges (was 30/60 days)
1-Step Challenge option: 10% target, 3% recalculating daily loss
ATR(14) x 0.8 trailing for intraday, x 1.5 for swing; 50/50 partial close at 3R
FTMO acquired OANDA — expect shift toward real-market execution
Challenge pass rate only 8-10%; true payout rate ~1.6-2%
All-in EURUSD cost ~0.7 pips (0.4 spread + $3/lot commission)
guidance: FTMO execution optimization research with 12 actionable implementation recommendations for NovaTrade automated trading system
